description:
LevelDB: Fix Win32Env::GetFileSize(), Win32SequentialFile::_Init() and Win32RandomAccessFile::_Init()

Fixed incorrect open error handing in Win32SequentialFile::_Init()
Fixed file sharing violation in Win32Env::GetFileSize(), Win32SequentialFile::_Init() and Win32RandomAccessFile::_Init()
After these fixes db/recovery_test is able to pass all tests.
